description: Manual funnel investigation dispatched at the canonical qualified id; analytics-agent reads the read-only API key, derives the signup cohort + intermediate steps + funnel conversion over web_fetch (posthog-funnel-debugger §1-4), files the breakdown to wiki/Knowledge/PostHog/FunnelDebugger/, and completes naming the biggest drop-off step plus a one-sentence hypothesis.

args.result: Funnel analysis filed to wiki/Knowledge/PostHog/FunnelDebugger/2026-06-12.md. Cohort 84 signups; biggest drop-off between workspace_created → first_message_sent (61% of users who create a workspace never send a message). Hypothesis: the empty-workspace state gives no prompt to send a first message — check the post-create screen.
args.digest: Funnel debugger ran on a 28d window, cohort 84 (above the directional threshold). Steps derived from activated paths, not guessed. Drop-off is mid-funnel, not last-mile — onboarding UX, not a bug. Logged the derived step order in MEMORY for reuse next trigger.
